This was head coach [[Brian Gregory]]'s seventh season at Dayton. The Flyers compete in the [[2009–10 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|Atlantic 10 Conference]] and played their home games at the [[University of Dayton Arena]]. They finished the season 25–12, 8–8 in A-10 play and lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2010 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament]].
